title: Get Instant Page events
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get the supported events for Instant Pages based on your objective types and optimization goals. > **Important**
> By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the [TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms](https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/business-products-terms) and that you will not share sensitive data with TikTok. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/pixel/instant_page/event/|/v1.3/pixel/instant_page/event/| |Request parameter type|`advertiser_id`: number
|`advertiser_id`: string
| |Request parameter name|`optimize_goal`|`optimization_goal`| |Response parameter name|`optimize_goals`
`optimize_goal`
`external_actions`
|`optimization_goals`
`optimization_goal`
`optimization_events` | |Response parameter enum value name|`business_type`: `CUSTOM_INSTANT_PAGE`|`business_type`: `TIKTOK_INSTANT_PAGE`| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/pixel/instant_page/event/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162). | ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {Required}|string| Advertiser ID| |objective_type {Required}|string|Objective type. Must be either `CONVERSIONS` or `APP_PROMOTION`.| |optimization_goal {Required}|string|Optimization goal| |is_retargeting|boolean| Whether it is for retargeting| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/pixel/instant_page/event/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&objective_type=CONVERSIONS&optimization_goal=CONVERT&is_retargeting=true --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-raw '{ "event_name": "{{event_name}}", "event_time": {{event_time}}, "event_id": "{{event_id}}", "properties": { "contents": [ { "content_id": "{{content_id}}", "content_type": "product" } ], "currency": "USD", "value": {{value}} } }' (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field{40%}|Data Type{10%}|Description{50%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|The return code. For the complete list of error codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string|The return message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |data |object|Return data| #|list|object[]|Data list| ##|business_type|string| Business type. Currently, the only supported value is `TIKTOK_INSTANT_PAGE`.| ##|instant_page_events|object| Instant page events| ###|objective_types|object[]|List of objective types| ####|objective_type|string|Objective type. Can be `CONVERSIONS`, `APP_PROMOTION`. | ####|optimization_goals|object[]|List of optimization goals| #####|optimization_goal|string|Optimization goal| #####|optimization_events|string[]|List of external actions. Currently, the only allowed value is `BUTTON`, which means button clicks.| |request_id|string| Unique ID of the request| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code json JSON) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "LOG_ID", "data": { "list": [ { "business_type": "TIKTOK_INSTANT_PAGE", "instant_page_events": { "objective_types": [ { "optimization_goals": [ { "optimization_goal": "CONVERT", "optimization_events": [ "BUTTON" ] } ], "objective_type": "CONVERSIONS" } ] } } ] } } (/code); ```
